title: Three-agent compaction chain at a 100k target
interpretation: Measure context growth, prefix reuse, latency and stall behaviour under repeated compaction. The prompt-compute counter peaks near 65k tokens/s because it credits work in bursts at request completion; that is not true PP. Read this as a compaction workload, not a clean throughput baseline.
provenance: ROCm 7.14 by recorded active profile and 6–8 October collection date; no immutable image ID captured per trace.
selection_reason: A 100k three-agent compaction-chain sweep; it investigates compaction rather than the selected 131k concurrency/runtime comparison

title: Three-agent compaction chain extended to 110k
interpretation: Probe the usable depth frontier for three concurrent agents. Compare latency and stall growth with the neighboring 90k and 100k cases.
provenance: ROCm 7.14 by recorded active profile and 6–8 October collection date; no immutable image ID captured per trace.
selection_reason: A 110k extension of the compaction sweep; different depth and history prevent a matched runtime comparison

title: Three-agent compaction chain at 90k
interpretation: Lower-depth reference for the three-agent chain. Use as a context for deeper compaction cases, not as an isolated hardware comparison.
provenance: ROCm 7.14 by recorded active profile and 6–8 October collection date; no immutable image ID captured per trace.
selection_reason: A 90k compaction reference; useful tuning context but redundant in the focused comparison

title: Four-agent compaction at 64k
interpretation: Shallow four-agent point used to see how compaction begins under concurrency. Compare the event/stall profile with deeper four-agent points.
provenance: ROCm 7.14 by recorded active profile and 6–8 October collection date; no immutable image ID captured per trace.
selection_reason: A shallow 64k four-agent compaction case; outside the long-context target

title: Four-agent compaction at 80k
interpretation: Intermediate-depth four-agent workload. Look for the onset of queue and compaction stalls as context grows.
provenance: ROCm 7.14 by recorded active profile and 6–8 October collection date; no immutable image ID captured per trace.
selection_reason: An 80k compaction-depth step; part of an exploratory sweep rather than a selected operating point

title: Four-agent compaction at 86k
interpretation: Narrow depth step within the compaction region. Treat small differences cautiously because workload history and cache state affect the storm profile.
provenance: ROCm 7.14 by recorded active profile and 6–8 October collection date; no immutable image ID captured per trace.
selection_reason: An 86k compaction-depth step near a workload cliff; not a matched ROCm comparison

title: Four-agent compaction at 90k
interpretation: Reference four-agent storm workload used repeatedly for later storage and link comparisons. This is deliberately sustained stress, not a short latency smoke test.
provenance: ROCm 7.14 by recorded active profile and 6–8 October collection date; no immutable image ID captured per trace.
selection_reason: A 90k four-agent compaction-storm reference; intentionally stresses prefix loss rather than the selected context-growth workload

title: Clean rerun after a prefill-threshold change
interpretation: Checks whether smaller prefill scheduling steps reduce long stalls. Interpret TTFT, prefill throughput and long-stall counts together; the change reduced some micro-stalls but did not eliminate total stall time.
provenance: ROCm 7.14 by recorded active profile and 6–8 October collection date; no immutable image ID captured per trace.
selection_reason: A prefill-threshold tuning rerun; changes scheduler configuration and is not a runtime-only comparison

title: Foreign-traffic-contaminated threshold trial
interpretation: Tainted comparison: unrelated traffic shared the service during collection. Keep it for provenance only; do not use its metrics to claim a treatment effect.
provenance: ROCm 7.14 by recorded active profile and 6–8 October collection date; no immutable image ID captured per trace.
selection_reason: Unrelated traffic contaminated the measurement; its metrics cannot establish a treatment effect

title: GPU-link upgrade comparison at the four-agent storm point
interpretation: Replays the reference workload after a link change. It improves average transfer/reload behaviour but does not resolve the long-tail stall mechanism.
provenance: ROCm 7.14 by recorded active profile and 6–8 October collection date; no immutable image ID captured per trace.
selection_reason: The GPU-link path changed; link bandwidth and runtime effects cannot be isolated

title: Clean-storage four-agent storm trial
interpretation: Tests whether a clean backing tier changes stalls. Compare storage traffic and stall timing; this precedes the loop-backed tier test.
provenance: ROCm 7.14 by recorded active profile and 6–8 October collection date; no immutable image ID captured per trace.
selection_reason: A backing-storage experiment; storage-path effects are outside the selected runtime comparison

title: Loop-backed fast-storage trial
interpretation: Tests the backing-store path with a capped loop device. Use memory telemetry alongside engine metrics to distinguish real tier use from idle capacity.
provenance: ROCm 7.14 by recorded active profile and 6–8 October collection date; no immutable image ID captured per trace.
selection_reason: A loop-backed storage experiment; it tests a tier implementation rather than the retained deployment profiles

title: Eight-agent overflow / RAM-tier boundary
interpretation: Intentionally exceeds the GPU plus host-memory working set so the backing tier must receive spill traffic. This is a capacity and survival stress test, not a normal operating point.
provenance: ROCm 7.14 by recorded active profile and 6–8 October collection date; no immutable image ID captured per trace.
selection_reason: An intentional eight-agent overflow boundary test; it exceeds the intended operating point

title: Reduced host-tier capacity at four-agent load
interpretation: Compares a smaller RAM tier with the previously tested larger tier. Watch swap, reload rates, memory headroom and deep-context latency.
provenance: ROCm 7.14 by recorded active profile and 6–8 October collection date; no immutable image ID captured per trace.
selection_reason: A smaller host-tier experiment; its memory budget differs from the retained profiles

title: Single-card RAM16 tier, four agents at 131k target
interpretation: Qualification run for the 16 GiB shared-memory tier with four agents on one card. It is the key smooth-operation milestone; read error count, turn completion, TTFT by depth and memory pressure together.
provenance: ROCm 7.14 by recorded active profile and 6–8 October collection date; no immutable image ID captured per trace.
selection_reason: Core single-card RAM16 capacity milestone or its resource trace

title: Single-card RAM16 tier, three agents at 150k target

title: Speculative-depth eight versus the four-agent baseline

provenance: ROCm 7.14 by recorded active profile and 6–8 October collection date; no immutable image ID captured per trace.
selection_reason: An eight-token speculation variant; draft-depth changes KV reservations and prevents an isolated runtime comparison

title: Six-agent capacity-bound run, incomplete

title: Dual-engine wall time: different revisions and KV formats, 19–21 October 2026
interpretation: Observed wall times for vllm-radiance Y/Z references versus radiance R1–R6, n=1–4. Historical non-spec walls are shorter; radiance MTP-4 walls are shorter. Revisions differ (9dba8a05 vs 81a28ee7), as do BF16 vs FP8 KV. The old baseline was not rerun; no controlled engine effect or significance is established.
provenance: Public 19 October Y/Z sweep and 21 October radiance 1.9.0 campaign exports; recovered harness, distinct target revisions and KV formats.
selection_reason: Retained engine-deployment observations with explicit confounds.

title: Single-card serving: per-turn price and TTFT, old engine vs radiance (22 October 2026)
interpretation: Whole-cell wall per timed turn and mean TTFT across vllm-radiance GPU A MTP-4, radiance TP1 MTP-4 and radiance TP2 MTP-4. n4 TP1 growth cap is 88,913 versus historical 126,000; observed maximum prompts are 99,075 versus 126,691. Total turn counts and 10/13 GiB host tiers differ. Lower observed waits are not an equal-depth engine speedup.
provenance: 18 October historical GPU A, 21 October radiance TP2 and 22 October radiance TP1 CSVs. Historical lane corrected to MTP-4 from its configuration JSON. Derived comparison rebuilt by tools/build_comparison_data.py.
selection_reason: Retained latency/depth tradeoffs; unequal run length, depth and configuration stated.

title: KV pool ceiling ladder: measured boots and marked projections (22 October 2026)
interpretation: Four measured GPU boot allocations: TP1 404,608; TP2 four-slot 524,304; TP2 six-slot 131k 786,448; TP2 six-slot 200k 1,228,816 tokens. The original TP2 pool was slot-target limited; TP1 was VRAM limited. Host finished-conversation storage is separate from live GPU KV. Elastic and driver-cap rows are projections; allocation does not qualify concurrent full-depth performance.
provenance: Recorded radiance 1.9.0 boot allocations, 21–22 October. Per-card density varies with allocation: 18.15 KiB/token at six-slot 131k, 17.74 at 200k. Dashed estimates remain unvalidated projections; a driver cap is not an available prefix-tier budget.
selection_reason: Measured allocations retained separately from finished-conversation tier and projections.
